svg.title: amp updated Now Playing with Bluetooth-in-transport and settings view
svg.desc: Two side-by-side mockups. The left shows the updated Now Playing view: a back button at the top, album artwork as a stylized vinyl record, track title Idioteque by Radiohead with inline metadata, a green scrubber with playhead, timestamps, a transport row of five buttons ordered Bluetooth, Previous, Play, Next, Loop with the Bluetooth button showing the active navy-inverted state and the Loop button also showing navy-inverted active state, a Lyrics button below with text-lines icon, a Track Info button below with an information circle icon, and the four-tab bottom navigation bar with Playing selected as a navy inversion. The right shows the Settings view: back button chrome, a yellow brutalist Settings block header, one setting row reading Show lyrics button with an OFF toggle button on the right and a subtitle explaining it requires embedded lyrics in track metadata, a large whitespace area below, centered app info reading amp v1.0.0, and the same tab bar with Library selected.

g.text: Requires embedded lyrics in track metadata
